verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs confirm wiki-style linking: typing `[[]]` creates or references any page, and `(())` references individual blocks. The pack contains no evidence of a backlinks panel or unlinked-mentions view, so only the linking part of the story is documented. Missing for 10: documented backlinks list shown in context, unlinked-mention detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the linking-graph experience.
